title: How to change cursor size in Cursor on Mac: a guide for better visibility
metaTitle: How to change cursor size in Cursor on Mac
description: Learn how to change cursor size in Cursor on Mac by adjusting system settings or editor zoom levels. Follow our guide for a clearer coding experience.
intro: To change the cursor size in Cursor on Mac, you must adjust the macOS system pointer settings or use the application zoom shortcuts. Cursor does not have a unique internal setting for the mouse pointer, so you rely on your Mac system configuration for the arrow and internal editor controls for text scaling.
tldr: Change the system-wide mouse pointer size via macOS System Settings.
Use Cmd + + or Cmd + - to zoom the Cursor interface.
Adjust specific editor font sizes in Cursor Settings under Appearance.
Use the Shake mouse pointer to locate setting for better visibility.

blocks.text: Many users want to change the cursor size in Cursor on Mac because the default pointer can get lost in complex code files. It is vital to understand that Cursor is a fork of VS Code. It inherits its interface behavior from that foundation. Because of this, Cursor does not manage the mouse pointer itself. The mouse pointer is a function of your macOS system settings. When you change the pointer size in macOS, it changes for every app you use, including Cursor.
How to change system mouse pointer size
If you are looking to make the actual mouse arrow larger, you must go outside the IDE. This is a system-level change. Follow these steps to adjust your pointer.

items: Click the Apple Menu () in the top left corner of your screen.
Select System Settings from the dropdown menu.
Navigate to the Accessibility section in the sidebar.
Click on Display to open the display settings.
Scroll down to the Pointer section.
Drag the Pointer size slider to your preferred size.

blocks.text: You will see the pointer grow or shrink in real time as you move the slider. This change takes effect immediately across your entire Mac. If you find that the pointer is still hard to find, you can enable the Shake mouse pointer to locate feature in the same menu. This makes the pointer grow significantly when you quickly move your mouse or trackpad finger.
Adjusting editor font size in Cursor

Sometimes when users ask how to change the cursor size, they actually mean they want the blinking text insertion point or the code text to be larger. If the text itself feels too small, changing the mouse pointer will not help. You need to adjust the font size within the Cursor settings.

items: Open Cursor and press Cmd + , to open the Settings menu.
Select the Appearance tab from the left sidebar.
Look for the Editor: Font Size field.
Enter a larger number to increase the size of your code text.
Press Enter to apply the changes.

blocks.text: This setting only affects the code editor window. It will not change the size of the sidebar, the chat panel, or the menus. If you need to change the size of those elements as well, you should use the global zoom feature instead.
Using global zoom for the Cursor interface

For a quick fix that scales the entire Cursor interface, use the built in zoom shortcuts. This is often the best way to handle issues where the chat panel or agent interface text is too small to read comfortably.

items: Press Cmd + + to zoom in on the entire Cursor window.
Press Cmd + - to zoom out if the interface becomes too large.
Press Cmd + 0 to reset the zoom to the default 100 percent.

blocks.text: This method works because Cursor is built on web technologies that support browser-like zoom. It is a reliable workaround if you find that specific panels are not responding to individual font size settings. It is especially useful if you are working on a high-resolution display where small text can cause eye strain during long coding sessions.

blocks.caption: Troubleshooting common cursor and UI size issues.

faq.question: Does Cursor have a dedicated setting for cursor size?
faq.answer: No, Cursor does not have a specific setting for the mouse pointer size. It uses the system-wide setting defined in your macOS Accessibility preferences.

faq.question: How do I make the chat panel text bigger?
faq.answer: There is no separate setting for the chat panel. Use the Cmd + + shortcut to zoom the entire Cursor window until the chat text is readable.

faq.question: Will changing the pointer size affect other apps?
faq.answer: Yes, changing the pointer size in macOS Accessibility applies to your entire Mac, not just the Cursor IDE.

task: Change the mouse pointer size in macOS and adjust the font size in the Cursor IDE.
appliesTo: Cursor on macOS (all versions from 12 Monterey onwards).

steps.name: Adjust System Pointer Size
steps.text: Go to System Settings, then Accessibility, then Display, and move the Pointer size slider.

steps.name: Change Editor Font Size
steps.text: Open Cursor Settings with Cmd + , and update the Editor: Font Size value.

steps.name: Zoom UI
steps.text: Use the zoom shortcut to scale the entire Cursor interface.

troubleshooting.fix: Use Cmd + + to scale the entire window instead of relying on font settings.
Re-enter your preferred font size in the Appearance tab of the Settings menu.

lazur.spoken: Where do I change the font size?
lazur.result: Lazur will point at the Font Size setting in your Appearance menu.
